Name: Panning Upgrades - Extra Config
Author: trashcan9
Description:
This mod adds additional options for the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12242]Panning Upgrades[/url] mod.

[size=5]Features[/size]
[list]
[*]Improve pan range when charging up upgraded versions.
[*]Only perform animation when next to water.
[*]Can increase the pan range or speed beyond iridium level in late-game.
[/list]

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Install requirements listed above under Requirements.
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.5.6 on Linux/macOS/Windows.
[*]Works in single player, multiplayer, and split-screen mode. If there are issues, please report them.
[*]Works well with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16235]Better Panning - Extra Config[/url]!
[/list]

[size=5]Configuration[/size]
[list]
[*]Configuration options allow you to modify setting. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] to adjust config in game.
[/list]

[size=5]Known Issues[/size]
[list]
[*]None currently.
[/list]
